title: SDS-22 stabilizes the PP1 catalytic subunits GSP-1/-2 contributing to polarity establishment in C. elegans embryos
authors: Li Y; Calvi I; Gotta M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究SDS-22稳定PP1磷酸酶催化亚基GSP-1/-2以维持线虫胚胎细胞极性，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: In many cells, cell polarity depends on the asymmetric distribution of the conserved PAR proteins, maintained by a balanced activity between kinases and phosphatases. The C. elegans one-cell embryo is polarized along the anterior-posterior axis, with the atypical protein kinase C PKC-3 enriched in the anterior, and the ring finger protein PAR-2 in the posterior. PAR-2 localization is regulated by PKC-3 and the PP1 phosphatases GSP-1/-2. Here, we find that, similar to GSP-2 depletion, depletion of the conserved PP1 interactor SDS-22 results in a partial rescue of the polarity defects of a pkc-3 temperature-sensitive mutant. Consistent with the rescue, SDS-22 depletion or mutation results in reduced GSP - 1/ - 2 protein levels and activity. The decreased levels of GSP-1/-2 can be rescued by reducing proteasomal activity. Our data suggest that SDS-22 contributes to polarity by protecting the GSP-1 and GSP-2 catalytic subunits from proteasome-mediated degradation, supporting recent data in human cells showing the SDS22 is required to stabilize nascent PP1.
abstract_zh: 在许多细胞中，细胞极性依赖于保守的PAR蛋白的不对称分布，这种分布由激酶和磷酸酶之间的平衡活性维持。秀丽隐杆线虫单细胞胚胎沿前后轴极化，非典型蛋白激酶C PKC-3富集于前部，环指蛋白PAR-2位于后部。PAR-2的定位受PKC-3和PP1磷酸酶GSP-1/-2调控。在此，我们发现，与GSP-2缺失类似，保守的PP1相互作用因子SDS-22的缺失导致pkc-3温度敏感突变体的极性缺陷部分恢复。与恢复一致，SDS-22缺失或突变导致GSP-1/-2蛋白水平及活性降低。GSP-1/-2水平的下降可通过降低蛋白酶体活性来恢复。我们的数据表明，SDS-22通过保护GSP-1和GSP-2催化亚基免受蛋白酶体介导的降解来促进极性，支持了人类细胞中最近的数据，显示SDS22是稳定新生PP1所必需的。
